notes.title: New Patch V2.0.4
notes.notes:
We've uploaded a new hotfix for Void Maker!

[b]V 2.0.4:[/b]
- Fixed finish level world record exploit
- Reverted impossible world records
- World records / Personal records small fixes
- Minor bug fixing


[i]For those who missed our [url=https://discord.gg/Xz4vNMqh2U]Discord [/url]announcement, our last update [b]V2.0.3[/b] included:
- Fixed some spikes not properly damaging you
- Fixed multiple starts/ends bug
- UI minor bug fixes (VoidLevel names length, favorites, etc.)
- Several backend fixes[/i]

notes.title: New Update V2.0.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

This last month we've been hard at work addressing post launch issues and working on porting to other platforms. We've also been following up bug reports, feedback and player recommendations, and are now happy to release a new update!

[b]V2.0.0 includes:[/b]
[i]- Blue Fire Tutorial level for new players (movement / abilities)
- Interface improvements
- Controller buttons and overall feel improvement
- All emotes are now unlocked in any level you play
- Npcs fixes
- Rates are now more accurate
- Ledge grab on movement fixed
- Hazard and dangerous objects improved
- New spawn sound system for objects and hazards
- Multiselecting the same kind of objects lets you change their parameters together
- Object movement improved
- Collision of some objects adjusted
- Level settings adjusted (Mana, Health, Spirits)
- Bug Fixes & Polish[/i]

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/bluefire]Blue Fire Discord Server[/url] to get in touch with the community, share your new levels and report any bugs you encounter!

Till next time!
Robi Studios

notes.title: Blue Fire: Void Maker Releases Today!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you to all those that played and created levels during the Blue Fire: Void Maker Early Access!

In honor of the original Blue Fire's anniversary, today we are launching [b]Blue Fire: Void Maker as a FREE spin-off[/b] on Steam. You don't need to own the original Blue Fire in order to play, but if you love what you've played, you can grab the game at the following link. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1220150/Blue_Fire/][h3]- Blue Fire -[/h3][/url]

Void Maker gives you the ability to create and share your very own Voids. Let your imagination run wild designing hardcore, epic or silly levels and sharing them with others!

[previewyoutube=DoMjjnPLnxY;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll be live streaming ourselves playing community-created levels on [url=https://discord.com/invite/bluefire]Discord[/url] today at 10am PT time, so join us to watch and a participate in a Q&A!

You can also share feedback on Discord and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RobiStudios]Twitter[/url] to learn about future updates. 

Cheers,
Robi Studios

notes.title: Happy Holidays Update
notes.notes:
We're wrapping up 2021... And we've got a new Void Maker Update to celebrate! 
Today we're releasing the Happy Holidays Update! 

The [b]Happy Holidays Update[/b] (Version number 0.3.0) includes:

[i]More than 50 new holiday models
Controller fixes and improvements (you can now play all of Void Maker with a controller)
Checkpoint fixes
Enemy fixes
Chest fixes
Fixed wallrunning on some assets
Sound design improvements
Light object fixed (lights now reset properly when traveling between levels)
UI and Menu fixes and improvements
Improved start on levels
Coins, Profiles, badges and profiles improved
New speed settings
Crashes and softlocks fixed
Movement of objects fixed
Duplicating objects fixed
Thumbnails fixed
& much more![/i]

Don't forget to join the official [url=discord.gg/bluefire]Blue Fire Discord Server[/url] to share feedback, report issues and share your levels with the community! 

We wish everyone a very merry holidays, we'll be back next year! 💙

notes.title: Blue Fire: Void Maker Now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you to all those that played and shared feedback during the Blue Fire: Void Maker PlayTest! We got some great notes that will help us ensure everyone has fun making and playing each other's levels when Void Maker fully releases early next year!

Starting today we are launching Void Maker into Early Access so anyone can try the Blue Fire level creation tool. Let your imagination run wild designing hardcore, epic or silly levels and sharing them with others! 

We ask that you please join the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/bluefire]Blue Fire Discord Server[/url] to share any feedback that you may have.

Void Maker is a new [b]free [/b]app on Steam, so you won't need to own the original [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1220150/Blue_Fire/]Blue Fire[/url] in order to play in Early Access or at full release. 

[previewyoutube=XtidQrtaXAM;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers,
Robi Studios

notes.title: Sarana Forest Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've got news for all Void Maker testers:  today we're releasing the Sarana Forest Update! 

The [b]Sarana Forest Update[/b] (Version number 0.2.1) includes:

[i]New assets, new enemies and more!
New post process actors
New camera cinematics actor
Toggle player abilities + ability chests
Loading maps from Browse is over 60% faster
Now you can collect coins after winning voids
View void creator profile
Voids now save record times, so you can show you beat a void faster!
Winrate for voids
Profile badge system
Chest items
More exposed parameters for actors
UI improvements
A huge amount of quality of life improvements, bug fixing and polish[/i]

To get access to the Playtest all you have to do is hit the [b]Get Access[/b] button on the Steam page! Recipients are chosen at random, and will be notified by Steam.

A huge thanks to each and every person who has been playtesting and reporting feedback, it's been super useful!
Hope you enjoy the update 💙

notes.title: Sign up for the Void Maker PlayTest!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Starting today we're opening a PlayTest for Blue Fire: Void Maker! 

We will select at random a limited number of people to try their hand at our very own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1220150/Blue_Fire/]Blue Fire[/url] level creation tool. Let your imagination run wild designing hardcore, epic or silly levels and sharing them with others! 

To enter for your chance at access, all you have to do is hit the [u][b]Get Access[/b][/u] button on the Steam page. Recipients are chosen at random, and will be notified by Steam. The Void Maker will launch as a new free app on Steam, so you won't need to own the full game in order to participate in the PlayTest!

If you are granted access, we ask that you please join the official Blue Fire [url=https://discord.com/invite/bluefire]Discord[/url] Server to share any feedback that you may have.

Thank you to all those who participate in the PlayTest to help us test the system and ensure everyone has fun making and playing each other's levels when it launches [b]early next year[/b]!

Cheers,
Robi Studios
